diagnosis: Check C6, which is supposed to depend on the customer deviation details in PF2, passed in 3 out of 4 rollouts despite the agent never having access to PF2. The model appears to be defaulting 'erialized_lot_traceability' to true as a generic safety/compliance heuristic when deciding not to authorize an alternate run.

C6.why: The approved customer deviation changes the run limit to exactly 600 housings, requires exactly 12 inspected first-off units and serialized traceability, and adds a customer-deviation record.

commitments.detail: A materials review and a compliance review must be obtained before releasing a non-routine material run.
